Class EMFAbstractCachedRoundRobinCandidateSelector<K extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.ENamedElement, V extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject>

io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFRoundRobinCandidateSelector<K,V>

Type Parameters:
K - the type of ENamedElement used as key (e.g., EClass, EAttribute)
V - the type of EObject to be selected
All Implemented Interfaces:
EMFCandidateSelectorStrategy<K,V>
Direct Known Subclasses:
EMFRoundRobinEClassCandidateSelector, EMFRoundRobinEObjectCandidateSelector, EMFRoundRobinFeatureMapGroupMemberSelector
public abstract class EMFAbstractCachedRoundRobinCandidateSelector<K extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.ENamedElement, V extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject> extends EMFRoundRobinCandidateSelector<K,V>
Abstract base class for cached round-robin candidate selectors.

This class provides caching functionality for round-robin candidate selectors, storing the computed candidate lists in an internal map to avoid redundant computations. Subclasses only need to implement the compute(EObject, ENamedElement) method to define how candidates are computed for a given key.

The cache is not exposed to subclasses, maintaining encapsulation and ensuring that all cache operations are managed by this base class.

Author:
Lorenzo Bettini

    • getOrCompute

      protected List<V> getOrCompute(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject context, K key)
      Get or compute the list of candidates for the specified key.

      If candidates for the given key are already cached, they are returned immediately. Otherwise, the compute(EObject, ENamedElement) method is called to compute the candidates, which are then cached and returned.

      Note: The context is captured by the lambda passed to computeIfAbsent, but the caching is based solely on the key. This means that the same cached result is used regardless of which context is provided in subsequent calls with the same key.

      Specified by:
      getOrCompute in class EMFRoundRobinCandidateSelector<K extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.ENamedElement, V extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject>
      Parameters:
      context - the EObject providing context
      key - the key for which to get candidates
      Returns:
      the list of candidates for the given key

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Reset all caches and state.

      Clears both the candidates cache and the round-robin state. This is useful when the model changes, ensuring that candidates are recomputed on the next call to EMFRoundRobinCandidateSelector.getNextCandidate(EObject, ENamedElement).

      Specified by:
